items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Um, I remember Phillip Nixon well.

ctx.x: Such as? How did that work? What you mean? Such as? Who were some of the bands? Oh, some of the bands I'd play with? Yeah, when you were with somebody else.

Oh, some time I played with Oryx when he was here, you know what I'm saying? And I was playing with Pierron and any other band at Warhammer like, oh, several of those bands rock. I played with Rennie, played with Rennie, played with Chris. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. And several others. Jack Carey. Mm-hmm. Played with him. Phillip Nixon, Silver Leaf Band. Who was in that band? Who was in that band?
Yeah, he played with him. Oh, he had... Who did you play with? Yeah. Yeah.
